documents.title: India crude import overview
documents.body: India imports more than 88 percent of its crude oil. Total crude imports were about 4.55 million barrels per day in July 2025 (EIA Country Analysis Brief, PPAC monthly data).

documents.title: Strait of Hormuz dependency
documents.body: A large share of India crude transits the Strait of Hormuz. Estimates range from about 30 to 45 percent depending on source and date.

documents.title: India strategic petroleum reserve cover
documents.body: India strategic petroleum reserves cover only about 9 to 10 days of net crude imports (CEEW, June 2026). Dedicated storage at Visakhapatnam, Mangaluru, and Padur.
